decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1/ The proposed vehicle crossover to this property,  which is situated close to a 
    zebra crossing, would, by reason of its  position, be a road safety hazard  and 
    is contrary to the Policies ENV 1.1 (All New Development), T2.7a		
    (Vehicle Crossovers and Hardstandings) and  T3.6 (Road Safety) of the 
    Unitary Development Plan and ENVB 1.1 (New Development), T5.3
   (Vehicle Crossovers and Harstandings), T4.4 (Road Safety) of the Revised 
    Deposit Unitary Development Plan and Residential House Extension 
    Guidelines.  

2/ The proposed vehicle crossover and hardstanding  to this property  would, by 
    reason of its  appearance  in relation to  neighbouring  properties, be unduly 
    unsightly, detrimental to the outlook and   amenities of adjoining occupiers and 
    the street scene and is contrary to the Policies ENV 1.1 (All New 
    Development) and T2.7a  (Vehicle Crossovers and Hardstandings)
    of the Unitary Development Plan and ENVB 1.1 (New Development) and T5.3 (Vehicle Crossovers and Hardstandings) of the  Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan and Residential House Extensions Guidelines.
description: Installation of vehicular crossover to existing dwellinghouse
